mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the GDP growth is negative, or if the correlation between GDP growth and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase by more than 5% in the last two months, it signals a strengthening demand for housing, which can lead to increased construction activity and related economic activity, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the same period, it signals a strengthening demand environment with a robust labor market, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of increasing RSAFS and decreasing UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
